categories.main_business_segments: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. operates three main business segments: Information Communication (magazines, books, advertising, digital content), Information Security (business forms, securities, cards, BPO, payment solutions), and Life & Industrial Materials (paper containers, flexible packaging, tubes, bottles, metal printing, building materials, electronic components, and high-performance materials). The group also engages in logistics and real estate management through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced printing, prepress, and bookbinding technologies, as well as digital content production and security printing (including anti-counterfeiting and IC card technologies). In packaging, it utilizes materials processing, high-function film development, and sustainable packaging solutions. R&D focuses on high-value-added printing, digital transformation, security features, and environmentally friendly materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kyodo Printing serves publishers, commercial clients, public institutions, financial institutions, transportation operators, manufacturers of food, daily goods, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals. Its end markets include publishing, advertising, government, finance, transportation (notably for tickets and IC cards), and consumer goods packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary operations are in Japan, with manufacturing and sales bases across the country. It also has overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in China (Shanghai), Vietnam, and Indonesia, focusing on packaging and materials for local and export markets. Over 90% of sales are domestic, but overseas expansion is a strategic focus, especially in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kyodo Printing operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing finished printed products, packaging, and security solutions directly to end-users and corporate clients. It also manages logistics and distribution for its products through group companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is shifting from traditional printing to information services and high-value-added solutions, emphasizing digital transformation (DX), sustainability, and global expansion. R&D priorities include sustainable packaging, digital content, security technologies, and high-performance materials. The group is investing in productivity improvements, M&A, and human capital, with a strong focus on ESG and climate change response.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of printed products, packaging materials, security solutions, and related services. The company also earns income from logistics, real estate leasing, and system development. There is a growing emphasis on service-based and solution-oriented revenue streams, such as BPO and digital content distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kyodo Printing is a leading diversified printing and packaging company in Japan, competing with other major printing groups such as Dai Nippon Printing (DNP) and Toppan. It differentiates itself through its integrated security solutions, advanced packaging technologies, and a balanced portfolio across publishing, security, and industrial materials. The company is recognized for its technical expertise and reliability in high-security and high-quality applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, consolidated sales were 99.98 billion yen, with operating profit of 2.33 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.31 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth (3.1% YoY), significant profit improvement (net profit up 121.3% YoY), and maintains a strong equity ratio (49.8%). The group employs over 3,200 people and is investing for future growth, targeting 120 billion yen in operating profit by 2034.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kyodo Printing emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, secure, and innovative solutions that address customer needs in publishing, security, and packaging. Its strengths lie in advanced materials processing, security printing, and sustainable product development. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for clients seeking reliability, compliance, and value-added services, with a strong commitment to ESG and digital transformation.
